name: Vegetable Garden Planning
description: Creates a vegetable garden plan with bed sizing, crop selection based on USDA hardiness zone, companion planting guidelines, and a zone-aware planting calendar. Produces a complete garden layout with planting schedule and expected harvest windows. Use when the user asks about starting a vegetable garden, planning garden beds, choosing vegetables to grow, companion planting, or creating a planting schedule based on their location. Do NOT use for ornamental garden design, indoor gardening (use indoor-plant-care), commercial farming, or flower garden planning.
